targets.purpose: Verify one-step critic targets and distinct physical-terminal, TimeLimit and slice handling.
targets.theoretical_expectation: Target is r+.95*(1-terminated)*V_old(next). Truncation alone and an ongoing slice retain bootstrap; true terminal wins when both flags are set.
targets.method: Independent hand targets plus actual CartPole collector transitions at forced physical/500-step boundaries, with constant old critic value2.
targets.explanation: A truncated boundary is not treated as a natural physical failure under this configured continuing-value bootstrap convention. One-step labels are numerical frozen data, while actor GAE is unchanged.

matched_first_update.purpose: Verify that the first paired comparison differs solely in critic regression labels.
matched_first_update.theoretical_expectation: Matched networks/policy/seed yield identical first observations/actions/GAE. Separate actor and critic networks imply identical actor updates on that first batch, while differing labels alter critic updates.
matched_first_update.method: Two actual64-step CPU rollouts with same seed764; independently recompute one-step labels from recorded next observations and frozen critic; optimize twice with identical minibatch RNG.
matched_first_update.explanation: The two recorded value losses use different labels and cannot establish which critic is more accurate. Later actor updates can diverge because each newly learned critic changes subsequent GAE estimates; only the controlled first batch must have identical actor updates.

checkpoint_resume.purpose: Verify actual one-step-critic train() configuration and numerical state survive interruption/resume.
checkpoint_resume.theoretical_expectation: Same143-step budget and seed with a pause after64 steps produce exact actor/critic/Adam/collector/RNG state and episode logs.
checkpoint_resume.method: Tiny full versus stopped/resumed production train() executions in automatically deleted temporary directories; exclude elapsed times from comparisons.
checkpoint_resume.explanation: This verifies the one-step flag persists through the real checkpoint lifecycle. It is a small correctness experiment, not a formal training-performance result.
